summary: Mars Atlas is an interactive web-based platform designed to integrate Martian geographic, scientific, and environmental data into a unified exploration environment. Focused on the Jezero crater delta, it combines 3D planetary visualization, scientific points of interest, terrain analysis, and route-planning tools to support the exploration and evaluation of different routes across the Martian surface.

7. Known limitations and pending work (TODO)

Data honesty

- MOLA elevations come from the image color, not the real DEM. For metric accuracy you need to use the true MOLA DEM.

- Weather, radiation, wind, O₂, and hazards are simplified models. No figure is validated for Mars.

- The EVA risk index is heuristic and uncalibrated.

- The 20° limit comes from a lunar EVA document; it is not a suit specification for Mars.

- Walking speeds with suit are assumptions.

Technical TODOs

- [ ] The Route tab analysis uses only MOLA (elevationAt); it does not take advantage of the local DTM.

- [ ] The analysis interpolates in a straight line between waypoints (no geodesics or detailed intermediate terrain).

- [ ] Trek URLs (layer names, extensions, max levels) need to be verified against WMTSCapabilities.xml; THEMIS layers have alternative URLs for that reason.

- [ ] The coordinates of Base, Kodiak, Enchanted Lake, and Hogwallow Flats must be set by hand and verified against HiRISE/Perseverance images.

- [ ] The local DTM covers only one area (Jezero bbox); there is no support for multiple DTMs.

- [ ] On very uniform terrain the 3 candidate routes may coincide.

- [ ] The grid and the A* run on the main thread (they could be moved to a Web Worker).

- [ ] Persistence only in localStorage (no accounts or sync).

- [ ] No automated tests.

Repository cleanup

- [ ] README.md is outdated: it mentions src/engine/procedural.ts, which CAMBIOS.md says to delete (it imports VIKING, which no longer exists in config.ts).

- [ ] pnpm-workspace.yaml has placeholder values (set this to true or false) that need to be resolved.

- [ ] CAMBIOS.md is a one-off update note; it should be merged into the README.
